change: Do not claim another job unless at least 30 seconds of the request allowance remain; a deliberately shorter one-job budget retains its original bounded behavior.
regression: A preceding 24-second read leaves the next original purchase queued with zero attempts and no lease; the following tick completes that same job identity.
limitations: Synthetic time passage with actual isolated PostgreSQL job claims, not a live provider timing guarantee.
Real unknown payment outcomes still pause the cohort and require original-resource reconciliation.
pauseBehavior: While a cohort is paused, only its named original interrupted ticket is eligible; other ticket jobs keep their attempt allowances until explicit continuation.
